property_summary: For any _feeRate input within the allowed range, calling initialize(...) sets c.feeRate() equal to the provided _feeRate; the mutant that adds 1 to assignment will cause c.feeRate() != _feeRate for some fuzzed _feeRate inputs.
change_summary: Replace the assignment feeRate = _feeRate; with feeRate = _feeRate + 1; so initialize sets feeRate to a different value.
